HomeHero.title: Every Customer Conversation Needs a
HomeHero.descriptionOne: Your team has enough on its plate.
HomeHero.descriptionTwo: Vinotoraup takes customer calls and follow-ups off it.

HomeTakeRecurring.descriptionOne: When routine calls and follow-ups fill the day, Vinotoraup can take on the work you choose to outsource.
HomeTakeRecurring.descriptionTwo: You decide what we handle, what stays in-house, and when a case comes back to your team.

HomeLessPressure.title: Less Pressure Behind the Scenes
HomeLessPressure.description: Outsourcing works best when your own team notices the difference too. Cinpc adds people and capacity where customer communication is creating bottlenecks.

fintech.title: A Handoff Built Around Your Rules
fintech.description: We agree on the tasks, workflows, and escalation points before work begins. The scope can then change as your customer volumes and priorities change.

lending.title: People Behind the Answers
lending.description: Vinotoraup gives customers someone to speak with and your team a clear way to pass on recurring work. Each conversation follows the process agreed with your business.

insurance.title: What’s Filling Your Queue?
insurance.description: Tell us which calls and follow-ups take up your team’s time. We’ll help identify what Vinotoraup can cover.

ServicesHero.title: Customer Operations You Can Move Off Your Team
ServicesHero.description: Cinpc handles recurring customer and operational work for businesses across the financial sector.

compliance.title: Compliance Support
compliance.description: Support routine customer-facing processes around the requirements and procedures set by your business.

collections.title: Collections Support
collections.description: Keep payment reminders, customer contact, and agreed collection follow-ups moving.

customerCare.title: Customer Care
customerCare.description: Handle everyday questions, requests, account-related concerns, and customer support conversations.

fraud.title: Fraud Support
fraud.description: Support customer communication around suspicious activity, verification, and cases requiring further review.

application.title: Application Support
application.description: Keep customers informed through applications, information requests, and required next steps.

complaint.title: Complaint Handling
complaint.description: Give complaints a clear route through response, follow-up, and escalation when needed.

ServicesCustomerJourney.title: One Customer Journey, Fewer Handoffs
ServicesCustomerJourney.description: A customer may start with a simple question and end up needing verification, a follow-up, or another team. Cinpc can connect several support functions within one outsourced setup instead of treating every conversation as a separate task.

ServicesDecide.title: Decide What Stays. Move What Doesn't.
ServicesDecide.description: You don't have to outsource the whole customer operation.
ServicesDecide.adjustScope: Adjust the scope as needs change

ServicesBuiltAround.title: Built Around Your Workflow
ServicesBuiltAround.description: Your processes come first. Cinpc works around defined responsibilities, communication requirements, and handoff points rather than forcing customer operations into a fixed service package.

ServicesHaveMore.title: Have More Than One Function to Cover?
ServicesHaveMore.description: Tell us where customer communication is creating extra work, and we'll help define what can move to Cinpc.

SolutionsHero.title: Support Built Around Financial Customer Journeys
SolutionsHero.description: Different financial businesses create different customer conversations. Cinpc adapts outsourced support around the operation behind them.

fintech.title: FinTech
fintech.description: Support customers using digital financial products with everyday questions, account-related requests, verification, and follow-ups.

lending.title: Lending
lending.description: Keep borrower communication moving across applications, payment reminders, questions, and ongoing customer contact.

insurance.title: Insurance
insurance.description: Handle customer inquiries, requests, follow-ups, and other recurring communication throughout the customer relationship.

financialServices.title: Financial Services
financialServices.description: Add external capacity to established customer operations without building another support function in-house.

SolutionsDifferentBusiness.title: Different Business. Different Queue.
SolutionsDifferentBusiness.description: The work that creates pressure in a lending company may look completely different from the workload of a FinTech platform. Cinpc lets you define the functions, conversations, and handoffs that belong in your outsourced setup.

SolutionsFits.title: Where Cinpc Fits In
SolutionsFits.description: Customer operations rarely stay inside one neat category. Support can be built around different points in the customer journey:

SolutionsKeepCore.title: Keep the Core.
SolutionsKeepCore.description: Your internal team can stay responsible for the decisions and functions that need to remain in-house while Cinpc covers the recurring communication around them.

SolutionsNeedSetup.title: Need a Setup That Fits Your Business?
SolutionsNeedSetup.description: Tell us what your customers contact you about and where your internal team needs more capacity.

ProcessHero.title: From Your Queue to Ours
ProcessHero.description: A clear setup keeps outsourcing simple. We define the work, prepare the workflow, launch the service, and adjust it as your operation changes.

map.title: Map
map.description: We identify the calls, customer conversations, and recurring tasks you want to move outside your internal team.

setUp.title: Set Up
setUp.description: Together, we define responsibilities, workflows, communication requirements, and handoff points.

goLive.title: Go Live
goLive.description: Cinpc begins handling the agreed operations within the setup established for your business.

adjust.title: Adjust
adjust.description: As volumes, priorities, or requirements change, the scope and workflows can change with them.

ProcessClearLines.title: Clear Lines from the Start
ProcessClearLines.description: Before launch, both teams know where responsibilities sit.
ProcessClearLines.afterList: This keeps the outsourced operation connected to your internal team without blurring responsibilities.
ProcessClearLines.handedBack: When a case is handed back
ProcessClearLines.situations: How different situations should be handled

ProcessYourWorkflow.title: Your Workflow Doesn't Disappear
ProcessYourWorkflow.description: Outsourcing doesn't mean rebuilding customer operations around someone else's system. Cinpc works within the processes and requirements defined for the functions you move outside.

ProcessBuilt.title: Built to Change with the Queue
ProcessBuilt.description: Call volumes and customer needs don't always stay predictable. The setup can be reviewed and adjusted when your operation needs different capacity or coverage.

ProcessReady.title: Ready to Map What Moves?
ProcessReady.description: Show us what is currently taking up your team's time, and we'll start by defining what Cinpc can take over.

CompanyHero.title: Built to Take Customer Operations Off Your Plate
CompanyHero.description: Cinpc is a call center outsourcing partner for financial businesses that need more capacity without adding another internal function.

CompanyAbout.title: About Cinpc
CompanyAbout.description: Cinpc is operated by Call Center Inp and provides outsourced customer and operational support across the financial sector.
CompanyAbout.descriptionSecond: We work as an extension of internal teams, taking responsibility for defined customer conversations, follow-ups, and recurring support tasks.

CompanyCloseEnough.title: Close Enough to Work as One Team
CompanyCloseEnough.description: Good outsourcing should make responsibilities clearer, not create another layer to manage.

processes.title: Your Processes
processes.description: We work around the workflows and requirements defined for your operation.

responsibilities.title: Clear Responsibilities
responsibilities.description: Both teams know what Cinpc handles, what stays in-house, and when a handoff is needed.

adapt.title: Room to Adapt
adapt.description: The setup can change as customer volumes, priorities, and operational needs change.

CompanyFocused.title: Focused on Financial Customer Operations
CompanyFocused.description: FinTech, lending, insurance, and other financial businesses deal with customer conversations that often require timely follow-up and clear handling. That is the environment Cinpc is built to support.

CompanyPeopleBehind.title: People Behind the Queue
CompanyPeopleBehind.description: Customer operations still come down to conversations: understanding the request, following the right process, and knowing what needs to happen next. Cinpc puts a dedicated external team behind that work.

CompanyLetsTalk.title: Let's Talk About Your Operation
CompanyLetsTalk.description: Tell us what is currently handled in-house and where you need additional support.

ContactHero.description: Give us the basics, and we'll start from there.

ContactNotSure.description: You don't need a finished plan before contacting us. Tell us where customer communication is taking up too much time, and we'll help define what can move outside your internal team.
